description: This file is a shell script named ipcalc.sh that functions as an IP address calculator utility. It processes IP addresses and netmasks in different formats, calculates network information such as broadcast address, network address, prefix, and range, and outputs these details. It appears to be a standalone utility script used for IP address calculations within the project.

methods.name: _ip2str
methods.description: Converts an integer IP address to a string representation, supporting decimal and hexadecimal formats based on flags.
